text: SALES INFORMATION The Company expects to sell 100 units in January, and increase sales units by 50 units over the prior month’s unit sales. The Company plans to keep the selling price at $10/item for all 3 months. Based on Company history, they expect that 30% of all sales will be paid for with cash and 70% of all sales will be paid for on credit. Questions: What is the total amount of sales for the 15t quarter? How much of each month’s sales will be cash and how much will be on credit?
